 Prakash D.Naik, Jj.

Despite there being successive Orders passed by the various co-ordinate benches of
this Court, Petitioner, an accused in an offence under Section 376 read with other
allied sections of Indian Penal Code has blatantly disclosed the name of victim as
Respondent No.2 and has also annexed her objectionable photographs.

2.  In view thereof, Petitioner is directed to pay cost of Rs.25,000/- to the Central Police Welfare Fund, Mumbai within a period of two weeks from the date of uploading of present Order on the official website of the High Court of Bombay.

The details of the bank account for payment of cost are as under :

sentences.text: Petitioner to deposit the said cost of Rs.25,000/- within stipulated period as noted above and submit the receipt of the same in the Registry of this Court.
3. Petitioner is also directed to amend the Petition thereby redacting the name of Respondent No.2 and remove 'Exhibit-C' collectively i.e. photographs of Respondent No.2 from the Petition.
This be done within a period of two weeks from today.
4. Assistant Registrar, Writ Cell, Criminal Writ Department is directed to keep 'Exhibit - C' in a sealed envelope, in the second part of the proceedings.

5. It is made clear that, if the Petitioner fails to deposit the aforestated cost and amend the Petition within stipulated period, the Petition shall stand dismissed within further reference to this Court and in that event, the trial Court will proceed with the trial of the present case expeditiously.
 (PRAKASH D. NAIK, J.) (A.S. GADKARI, J.)
